description: Pin multi-arch base and uv digests, install holon-coherence via frozen uv.lock export, add a container HEALTHCHECK, and tighten .dockerignore.
goal: Update Dockerfile in holon-coherence: pin base image to multi-arch digest FROM mitmproxy/mitmproxy:12.2.3@sha256:00b77b5d8804c8ad18cb6caefbf9d5849e895e8986c5ce011f4ae30f4385962f; copy uv from pinned multi-arch image COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.9.5@sha256:f459f6f73a8c4ef5d69f4e6fbbdb8af751d6fa40ec34b39a1ab469acd6e289b7 /uv /usr/local/bin/uv; copy pyproject.toml, uv.lock, README.md, and src/ into /app/ and install dependencies against uv.lock into system Python using uv export --frozen --no-dev --no-editable --no-hashes --no-header -o /tmp/requirements.txt && uv pip install --system --no-cache -r /tmp/requirements.txt && rm -f /tmp/requirements.txt plus --no-deps installation of the project (no pip install); add HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=10s --retries=3 probing 127.0.0.1:${PORT:-8080} via python3 TCP socket connect.

Update .dockerignore to exclude .git, .venv, .pytest_cache, .ruff_cache, __pycache__, *.pyc, *.pyo, dist, build, *.egg-info, .holon, tests, docs, plans, executions, holon-knowledge, .github, scripts, config, Makefile, environment.yml, and *.md while keeping !README.md so Dockerfile COPY README.md succeeds.

Add tests/test_dockerfile_packaging.py verifying all pinned multi-arch digests, uv.lock frozen export and uv pip install --system (no pip install), HEALTHCHECK instruction, and .dockerignore exclusions including !README.md without requiring a running Docker daemon.

Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show. In holon-coherence, Python files must have zero docstrings and zero comments. Do not modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json or any file under src/.
rationale: Dockerfile currently uses an unpinned tag, bypasses uv.lock with pip install, lacks a container HEALTHCHECK, and leaves dev, test, docs, and ledger trees in the Docker build context.
acceptance_criteria: `holon-coherence` can locate Docker/build assets cleanly when installed as a wheel, and `Dockerfile` locks dependencies against `uv.lock` via `uv export --frozen` and `uv pip install --system` while pinning multi-arch digests and defining `HEALTHCHECK`.
`.dockerignore` excludes tests, docs, plans, executions, ledger, CI, and build caches while preserving `!README.md` for `Dockerfile` packaging.

Unit tests in `tests/test_dockerfile_packaging.py` pass under `uv run pytest` verifying pinned `Dockerfile` digests, `uv.lock` install steps, `HEALTHCHECK`, and `.dockerignore` entries without requiring a Docker daemon.
